## Purpose and evidence standard

This note covers Department of Health and Aged Care / DHDA health products in
the current `fplida` build. The current PLIDA metadata groups `AIR`, `MBS`,
`PBS`, `MCD`, and `NACDC` under the health-related source group.

Schema/value claims are labelled as:

| Evidence label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Official | Backed by an official public source linked in this guide. |
| Local generator | Observed in current `fplida` code, tests, item lookups, generated smoke data, or foundation files. |
| Unresolved | No source was found in this pass. Do not use as calibration truth. |

## Source-backed coverage decisions

| Product area | What the research source supports | What is still not found |
|---|---|---|
| MBS | MBS Online and the classification specifications are official anchors for schedule items and classification fields such as category, group, subgroup, and subheading. | I did not find an official source for the generated claim-amount distributions; the amount quantiles remain smoke-output evidence. |
| PBS | The PBS API data dictionary is the official anchor for PBS item, prescribing-rule, co-payment, restriction, ATC, prescriber, organisation, and related concepts. The PBS fees page supports the current `$25.00` general and `$7.70` concessional co-payment thresholds. | I did not find an official source for the generated benefit/contribution amount distributions or all compact prescriber/pharmacy/under-copayment flag labels. |
| AIR | Health guidance establishes AIR reporting context and points to reporting-rule data elements. | I did not find a public AIR code table for every generated compact antigen, episode-status, and schedule-classification value. |
| NACDC | AIHW NACDC sources and the May 2026 table specifications support aged-care concepts and expose source data-item names, types, and value lists for sex, Indigenous status, country of birth, marital status, state, care approvals, and functional-capacity fields. | Generated `COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH`, `INDIGENOUS_STATUS`, `MARITAL_STATUS`, `CARE_TYPE`, and `HCP_LEVEL` are compact local representations rather than source-equivalent public NACDC code values; `STATE` needs its crosswalk tightened to an ASGS `STE_CODE`-style field rather than `RECIPIENT_STATE`. |
| MCD | Services Australia statistics pages are context sources for Medicare administrative statistics. | I did not find a public MCD variable-level codebook for generated consumer-status and program-code labels. |

## Product inventory

The metadata lists forty-eight health products. Current `fplida` generation is
more compact than the full DIL inventory.

| Dataset | Metadata products | Current generator output |
|---|---:|---|
| `MBS` | 20 | Yearly parquet claims plus DHDA spine. |
| `PBS` | 20 | Yearly parquet claims plus DHDA spine. |
| `AIR` | 1 | One vaccination/event parquet product. |
| `MCD` | 1 | Medicare enrolment product plus Services Australia spine. |
| `NACDC` | 6 | One aged-recipient parquet product plus AIHW spine. |

## Variable-level schema register

Every generated variable observed in this pass for this guide is listed in
[`schema-registers/schema-register-dhda-health.csv`](schema-registers/schema-register-dhda-health.csv).
The register records R type, sampled generated missingness, sampled generated
domains/distributions, and direct PLIDA metadata matches. Treat those sampled
domains/distributions as implementation evidence only, not as official source
data.

A rendered variable evidence appendix for this guide is available at [`variable-evidence-appendices/dhda-health-variable-evidence.qmd`](variable-evidence-appendices/dhda-health-variable-evidence.qmd). It contains one row per generated variable with observed generated values or distributions, local metadata/crosswalk status, and unresolved-source caveats.

The source-audited variable-code evidence register is
[`dhda-health-variable-code-evidence.csv`](dhda-health-variable-code-evidence.csv),
with a rendered companion at
[`dhda-health-variable-code-evidence.qmd`](dhda-health-variable-code-evidence.qmd).
That register is the controlling source for whether generated values are
source-equivalent, concept-only, or local synthetic evidence.

| Dataset | Generated variable rows | Direct PLIDA metadata matches | No direct PLIDA name match |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `AIR` | 11 | 6 | 5 |
| `MBS` | 24 | 24 | 0 |
| `MCD` | 10 | 10 | 0 |
| `NACDC` | 13 | 5 | 8 |
| `PBS` | 30 | 30 | 0 |

Rows without a direct PLIDA match need a generated-name to DIL-name crosswalk
before they are treated as source variables. `generated-variable-crosswalk.csv`
maps all five compact AIR fields to same-dataset AIR metadata and maps seven of
eight compact NACDC fields to same-dataset NACDC metadata. That is only a
concept/name crosswalk. The new source-evidence register shows that several
NACDC generated value domains are not source-equivalent to the May 2026 public
table specifications: `COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH` is local `0`/`1` rather than SACC
country codes; `INDIGENOUS_STATUS` is local `Y`/`N` rather than 1/2/3/4/9;
`MARITAL_STATUS` uses compact labels including `Single`; `CARE_TYPE` uses
compact service-family labels; and `HCP_LEVEL` uses local 1-4 levels. `STATE`
is compatible with ASGS `STE_CODE`-style values, but the current concept
crosswalk points to `RECIPIENT_STATE` abbreviations and needs tightening.

### NACDC aged care

The official Gen Aged Care Data source describes the National Aged Care Data
Clearinghouse as aged-care linked administrative data. The current generator
emits a compact aged-recipient product rather than all six metadata products.

| Variable | Type | Expected values or distribution | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SYNTHETIC_AEUID` | Character ID | AIHW agency person key. | Local generator |
| `BIRTH_MONTH`, `BIRTH_YEAR` | Integer | Birth month/year. | Local generator |
| `SEX` | Categorical/code | Sex code from source spine. | Local generator; same-dataset NACDC metadata crosswalk to `SEX_CODE` |
| `COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH` | Categorical/code | Local observed/generated domain `0`, `1`. Public NACDC table specifications use SACC country-of-birth code/description fields. | Local generator; concept match only; not source-equivalent to public SACC-coded NACDC fields |
| `INDIGENOUS_STATUS` | Categorical/code | Local generated `Y`/`N` binary Indigenous-status collapse. Public NACDC table specifications use 1 = Aboriginal, 2 = Torres Strait Islander, 3 = both, 4 = neither, 9 = not stated/inadequately described. | Local generator plus public NACDC table specifications; not source-equivalent to public NACDC codes |
| `MARITAL_STATUS` | Categorical/code | Local generated labels include `Married`, `Widowed`, `Divorced`, `Single`. Public NACDC table specifications use code/description values including divorced, married, separated, never married, widowed, and unknown. | Local generator; compact subset/renaming; not source-equivalent |
| `STATE` | Integer/code | Local observed/generated domain 1 to 8. Public NACDC table specifications include ASGS state/territory codes 1 to 9 and three-letter state abbreviations. | Local generator; crosswalk should target ASGS `STE_CODE`-style fields, not `RECIPIENT_STATE` abbreviations |
| `CARE_TYPE` | Categorical | Tested domain `CHSP`, `HCP`, `RAC`, `TCP`; compact service-family label. Public NACDC table specifications use fuller approved-care/service text. | Local generator/test; concept match only; not exact public field coding |
| `HCP_LEVEL` | Integer/categorical | Local generated HCP level 1 to 4 where relevant. Public NACDC table specifications expose HCP approval concepts, not this exact compact field. | Local generator; value labels unresolved and not source-equivalent |
| `ENTRY_DATE`, `EXIT_DATE` | Date | Aged-care entry and exit dates. | Local generator |
| `FUNCTIONAL_CAPACITY_SCORE` | Numeric/integer | Tested range 0 to 100. | Local generator/test; same-dataset NACDC metadata crosswalk to `FUNCTIONAL_CAPACITY_ENTRY` |

## Research uses and limits

Health products are central to fplida examples because they support service
use, medicine use, immunisation, aged-care, and enrolment observability. The
major risk is overclaiming source fidelity. MBS and PBS item-level realism must
come from the item schedules/lookups; generated claim amounts are local
synthetic outputs unless benchmarked against official aggregate statistics.

## Build implications

1. Keep MBS and PBS parquet-only and year-partitioned; the local wrappers and
   Rust modules are already designed around year-level output.
2. Add explicit codebook joins for MBS/PBS item, group, and flag labels before
   writing research examples that interpret specific item classes.
3. AIR antigen domains are locally tested; official AIR reporting-rule data
   elements should be linked before labels are published.
4. NACDC and MCD need wider product coverage if future builds need the full
   DIL health inventory.

## Validation checks to add

| Check | Evidence basis |
|---|---|
| MBS amounts are non-negative and `BENPAID <= FEECHARGED` when applicable. | Local generator and payment logic. |
| PBS date ordering: supply date should not precede prescribing date unless a real exception is sourced. | Local generator. |
| PBS indicator variables remain in `N`/`Y`. | Local smoke/test evidence. |
| AIR antigen code remains within the tested local domain. | Local test. |
| NACDC `CARE_TYPE` and functional score ranges stay within tested domains. | Local test. |
